description:
Role: Power BI Developer with C#, ASP.Net exp 
 Location: Redmond, WA 
 
 Job Description: 
 Looking for developers with Master’s degree from an accredited college/university in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or related fields with 8 plus years of experience.
 
 Mandatory Skills: 
 Must have worked for Microsoft at least 1 year during the last 3 years
 Excellent T-SQL skills, write complex queries, create views and Store procedures
 At least 1 year experience working with SSAS, building cubes and writing MDX queries
 2 years of experience in working closely with data analyzing data, understanding the patterns
 ability to derive insights 
 
 3 years plus experience in building reports and visualization using SSRS or other reporting tools
 Ability to create appealing visualization for derived datasets
 1 plus year(s) experience using Power BI – Power View, Power Query
 1 Plus year experience building dashboards using Power BI
 3 Plus years of experience in C#, ASP.Net 
 Experience in Data Analysis, understanding trends and patterns in data and create insights 
 Experience creating Web Widget and integrating it with Power Bi Dashboards 
 Good To Have Skills and Experience: 
 Experience creating Tabular cubes is an advantage.
 Working knowledge using SharePoint to publish reports
 
 Any

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
